Hi Samantha — thanks for the files and the notes. Quick checklist from our side so we can create the vendor record and confirm PO routing: 

- Can you confirm the legal entity EXACTLY as it should appear on our vendor record (inc punctuation and suffix)? You listed "Astra Logistics, Inc." above — please confirm.
- Please provide the EIN/TIN as it appears on the W-9 (we have the W-9 attached but the scanned copy is slightly blurry).
- For PO routing: is procurement@astralogistics.com the address you want listed as the default PO recipient? If you prefer an ERP code/EDI, please share the EDI endpoint and ISA IDs.
- Contact details: who should we set as the AP escalation contact (name + direct line)?

I have looped in Kimberly from AP (cc) to confirm internal requirements: Kimberly, can you confirm if we need any extra tax paperwork (state forms) for CA vendors, and whether ACH is sufficient for first payment?

I attached our vendor intake checklist (redwood_vendor_checklist_v1.2.pdf) — completes the items we normally require for vendor master creation. Estimated turnaround once we have the confirmed details and clear W-9: 3-5 business days.

Hi Samantha — welcome. A couple of clarifications from AP to avoid delays: 

- We can set procurement@astralogistics.com as the default PO email. If invoices are routed to a separate address please tell us now.
- ACH is fine for payments; we require the ACH form to be signed and the bank to provide a voided check or equivalent bank verification (PDF is fine).
- For tax compliance: CA has no additional vendor tax form beyond the federal W-9 in most cases — we'll confirm once we have the exact TIN.
- Please indicate whether Astra is considered a reseller or if you will be invoicing us as a services provider (this affects how we map GL codes).

If you can send a clearer copy of the W-9 showing the EIN and a contact for AP escalation (name + mobile), we can proceed to create the vendor in our ERP and return a Redwood vendor ID.

Thanks — I'll watch for the updated docs.
